name: Manba Finance Ltd
title: Manba Finance Ltd - 544262 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Small two-wheeler-led NBFC growing AUM 29% to INR 1,713 cr with NIM 13.63% and ROE 11.65%; supply-side signals are thin, and it is raising equity at a discount to its prior trading level.

triggers.label: AUM growth 25-30%, to INR 2,300-2,400 cr
triggers.quote: we will end up around INR 2,300 to INR 2,400

triggers.label: Borrowing cost 11.25% → 10.50%
triggers.quote: we are borrowing presently at 10.50% and it has been almost reduced from our previous borrowing which was around 11.25%

triggers.label: 2-Wheeler growing ~14% in April
triggers.quote: 2-Wheeler is the product which has been grown by almost 14%

triggers.label: Equity raise may slip to Q3/Q4
triggers.quote: it can go into the 3rd or maybe the 4th Quarter

guidance.value: 25-30% annually; AUM INR 2,300-2,400 cr by year end
guidance.quote: we will end up around INR 2,300 to INR 2,400
the 2-Wheeler ratio will be around 65% and 35% will be other products

guidance.value: Q2 or Q3 FY27, possibly Q3/Q4
guidance.quote: it can go into the 3rd or maybe the 4th Quarter
credit loss is around 1% to 1.25% only across the year

red_flags.label: Provision coverage ratio raised 24%→26%
red_flags.quote: why is the provision coverage ratio has been increased for the company like from 24% to 26%

red_flags.label: Equity raise timing pushed out
red_flags.quote: we may postpone for three to four months once this geopolitical problem issues get settled

red_flags.label: 3-Wheeler EV collection risk
red_flags.quote: funding 3-Wheeler and collection of 3-Wheeler is always very, very challenging

evasions.topic: Credit loss FY26 vs prior year
evasions.quote: No, so credit loss was almost similar than the previous years. It is around 1.25% 1.25%
we may postpone for three to four months once this geopolitical problem issues get settled
